parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$x^3-3x+3=2x^3-4x^2+3\Rightarrow x^3-4x^2+3x=0$ — M1; reduce to a three-term cubic or quadratic if $x$ cancelled.
$x(x-1)(x-3)=0$ — DM1; factorise the cubic or quadratic.
$x=0,1,3$ — A1; $x=0$ may be seen in working. SC B1 for $x=1,3$ only with no M marks.
Total: 3

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Attempt integration of both functions, before or after subtraction — M1; expect $\int((x^3-3x+3)-(2x^3-4x^2+3))\,dx$ or $\int(-x^3+4x^2-3x)\,dx$; subtraction may initially be either way.
$\pm(-\dfrac{x^4}{4}+\dfrac{4x^3}{3}-\dfrac{3x^2}{2})$, or equivalent difference of two antiderivatives — A1 OE; $\pm$ permits subtraction the other way.
Correctly apply limits their $1$ and $3$ — DM1 OE; need at least one correct substitution in every bracket, and if using two integrals, substitution into both. Do not allow if $x=0$ used. Allow one sign error only in each expression if brackets are absent.
$\dfrac83$ — A1; accept use of reversed limits with reversed subtraction, or AWRT $2.67$; dependent only on the first M1.
Total: 4
